Definition: from G501; a baling-vessel:--thing to draw with.
BiblicalUsage: The Samaritan woman leaves her waterpot and asks for the living water, that she may not have to come and draw. The word is the vessel for drawing, the bucket let down into the well.
TheologicalSignificance: One word for a drawing vessel carries no doctrine of its own; its thirst is the woman's, that she might never have to draw again.
